title: DEHU contact phone
blocker: The DEHU contact response includes a stored telephone field. The current contact editor and official help describe email and push devices, with no telephone or SMS editor.
unblock: Provide a documented DEHU telephone update control and a redacted request before building a write path.
notes: front offers no field for it (e-mails and push only), so no write is
built. `dehu quitar-email` uses the front's PUT
`v1/contact/<base64     NIF>`, which answers a Cl@ve form that applies the
change; adding an e-mail (and its `verify-email` code) is not built yet.

The current public contact view uses email and push controls. Its transport mapper carries telefono through the contact record, while the current view has no telephone input. The help documents email management and mobile push registration through Notifica App. The CLI describes phone as a stored data field. Source: https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/ayuda/consultas-informaticas/notificaciones-electronicas-ayuda-tecnica/recibir-avisos-nuevas-notificaciones-comunicaciones-dehu.html
